name: Lingo
description: This project is a React-based web application designed for a company that offers online language learning services. The app consists of three pages, featuring user authentication, teacher listings, and a favorites section. Below, you'll find an overview of the project's purpose, core technologies, and functionality.

name: Restaurant Selva
description: Meal Explorer is a React app that fetches meal data from an external API. The Menu page displays the first 5 meals, with a search bar that fetches matching meals as the user types. A loading indicator appears during data fetch, and user-friendly error messages are shown on failure. The Home page includes navigation, a banner, general info, top 3 meals, a MORE button to load additional meals, and contact details.

name: Camper Hire
description: TravelTrucks is a web application designed for a camper rental company. This project implements the frontend of the application using modern web technologies to provide an intuitive and user-friendly experience. Users can browse available campers, filter them based on specific criteria, view detailed camper pages with reviews, and book campers directly through the website.
